_note: Body profile: what the generator scales the anatomy to. The source models are one individual; a profile says which body we actually want, and every derived quantity — segment lengths, segment masses, muscle f0 — follows from it.
name: Atleta alto

_sources.segment_mass: de Leva 1996 (adjustments to Zatsiorsky-Seluyanov), fractions of body mass
_sources.muscle_volume: Handsfield et al. 2014 — muscle volume scales with mass x height
_sources.muscle_architecture: Ward et al. 2009 — PCSA and fascicle length

_note_scale: Uniform for now: the reference skeleton is 1.75 m, so a profile of another height scales by the ratio. Per-segment anthropometric ratios (Drillis & Contini) are the refinement, not yet applied.
